scheme_name: Bunkar Parivar Ke Pratibhavan Chatra-Chatraon Ko Protsahan Puraskar Yojana
other_conditions: Student’s parent must be a regular member of a primary weaver cooperative society affiliated with the Chhattisgarh Rajya Hathkargha Vikas Evam Vipanan Sahkari Sangh Maryadit, Raipur
Student must be a resident of Chhattisgarh state
Student must have passed the 10th or 12th board examination with at least 60% marks
Parent’s income from weaving must constitute more than 50% of the total family income
Weaver family includes husband, wife, and their children
benefits_summary: Monetary incentives up to ₹20,100 for students scoring 90%+ in 10th/12th board examinations.
